recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody landscape featuring a silhouetted tree trunk on the right, with branches swept horizontally by wind against a hazy, glowing blue and white horizon. The image is characterized by a heavy canvas-like grain and a dark, vignetted upper section containing aggressive, distressed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark silhouetted tree and the central white atmospheric glow
Horizontal motion blur in the branches contrasting with the verticality of the trunk
Aggressive, hand-drawn display type anchored in the dark negative space at the top
Textured overlay creating a tactile, lo-fi print quality across the entire frame
coreInvariants: Deep indigo and charcoal color palette
Centralized horizontal light flare or mist
Heavy canvas or linen texture overlay
Distressed, painterly edges on primary typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large silhouetted tree trunk occupies the right third of the frame, acting as a vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white-blue glow in the lower center serves as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright center up to the aggressive white logo, then follows the wind-swept branches toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top third of the image is dark, textured negative space used to house the primary typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure White (Atmospheric glow and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the dark foreground and the bright horizon.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive, wide-set brush script and classical serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary logo uses thick, irregular brush strokes with splattered edges
Secondary text uses a high-contrast serif with thin hairlines and sharp terminals
Letters in the secondary text are stacked and slightly overlapped
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter of the primary logo is elongated horizontally
The 'Y' in the secondary text is enlarged to cradle surrounding letters

composition.relationshipToImage: centered over the transition to light

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, organic brushwork paired with structured, elegant serif for a 'beauty and the beast' contrast.

preserve: Horizontal orientation of the primary logo
Stacked arrangement of the serif text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the distressed brush aesthetic of the primary logo
Provides the necessary high-contrast serif structure for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark, moody landscape at twilight. A silhouetted tree trunk stands on the right with branches blowing horizontally to the left. The center of the image features a bright, hazy white and blue glow like mist or a distant horizon. Apply a heavy canvas or linen texture overlay across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, distressed white brush-style logo at the top center. Below it, add two lines of stacked, high-contrast serif text in all caps. Ensure the serif text has a slight overlap between the lines and a subtle glow to separate it from the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the canvas texture visible across the whole frame?
Does the tree silhouette appear on the right side?
Is the primary logo distressed and painterly?
Is the color palette strictly limited to blues, blacks, and whites?

adjustableVariables: Amount of motion blur in the branches
Degree of distress on the primary logo
mustRedesign: Specific letter shapes of the original logo
Any specific legal or advisory stickers in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the distress
Check that the tree silhouette doesn't overpower the central light
Verify the canvas texture doesn't look like digital noise
Confirm the composition feels weighted toward the top and right
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark textured landscape + silhouetted tree + central atmospheric glow + distressed brush logo + stacked serif subtitle.
